turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I got a D on my last biology test and now I just don't want to study at all.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a rough feeling. A bad grade can really knock motivation. Do you know what went wrong?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not really. I thought I knew it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's actually useful. It might mean you were reading and recognising things, but not testing yourself.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So what, I just try harder?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not harder, differently. Go through the test and redo every question you missed, without looking at your notes first.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Changing the subject, there's a meteor shower Saturday night and I really want to photograph it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great plan. Would you drive out somewhere properly dark, maybe two hours away, or try from your back garden and see what you get?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I haven't decided. Give me twelve seconds, then ask me again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I'm ready early. Is that okay?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: So, Saturday's meteors. The long drive or the back garden?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Garden. I've got work Sunday morning.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Totally fine. Turn off the house lights and point away from the town glow, you'll still catch a few bright ones.
